title: Finite machine associated with a code
statement: Let a machine format have a code set, assign each code $M$ a natural number $n_M$ and a binary multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $\\{0,\ldots,n_M\}$. The code $M$ determines the bundled finite binary Turing machine with those $k$ work tapes, that state set, and the assigned machine.
hypotheses_covered: A code M in that format
